name: time-tracking-app
description: Time Tracking for Starhive: log hours on any object, see who logged what, and how it adds up per person and per month.

scripts.test: tsc src/timeEntry.ts src/report.ts --outDir .test-build --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler && sed -i '' "s|from './timeEntry'|from './timeEntry.js'|" .test-build/report.js && node src/timeEntry.test.mjs && node src/report.test.mjs
